meta.title: Vendors can be searched, filtered and added manually via Participants

plan.title: Manually Add Vendor to Auction Participants

steps.note: Open the eRFX creation flow, whose default stage is Auction.
Provide the required event title using a unique generated value.
Apply the auction pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required auction line item.
Commit a valid bidding schedule so the event can be published.
Add the initial participant required for a usable published event.
Publish the auction so its Participants screen is available.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Open the auction's Participants screen where manual vendor additions are performed.
Search the product's vendor catalogue and add one vendor manually.
Assert that the manually added vendor is listed as a participant.
Confirm the participant list increased by exactly one after the manual addition.
